arguments.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS online_fraction FROM transactions
arguments.explanation: Returns the share of all transactions whose transaction_type is 'Online Transaction', as a fraction between 0 and 1.
assumptions: 'All transactions' means every row in the transactions table, including the roughly 33% with no fraud label, since this is not a fraud rate.
The fraction is returned as a value between 0 and 1, not as a percentage.
The full data period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 is included.
